policy_title: Restore Community Policing and Investigate Burglaries
stated: Restoring proper community policing, where officers are visible, trusted and focused on preventing and solving crimes – especially rape and other violent crime. Creating a new statutory guarantee that all burglaries will be attended by the police and properly investigated.

source.quote: Restoring proper community policing, where officers are visible, trusted and focused on preventing and solving crimes – especially rape and other violent crime. Creating a new statutory guarantee that all burglaries will be attended by the police and properly investigated.

bearing_set.reason: Directly targets crime prevention, police visibility, and investigation of burglaries and violent crime — core Safety & Security indicators.

The policy explicitly centres visible, trusted officers and community relationships; community policing is a primary evidence-based lever for police-community trust and social trust — direct O15 indicators, not merely instrumental to crime reduction.

A statutory guarantee that every burglary is attended and investigated is a material resource commitment (hundreds of thousands of incidents annually currently unattended); without a stated funding mechanism this is an unfunded spending pledge bearing on the sustainability of the public finances.

membership_note: Three genuine bearings: O5 (safety/justice — the designed-for outcome), O15 (community trust — explicitly targeted by the 'visible, trusted' framing and supported by community-policing evidence), and O12 (fiscal — the burglary-attendance statutory guarantee implies significant additional policing resource with no stated funding source).
